mcqs.question: Which institution received the UGC Letter of Approval for establishing a campus in Bengaluru in September 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Birkbeck, University of London received the UGC Letter of Approval for its Bengaluru campus. The University Grants Commission issued the approval, while the University of London is the federation to which Birkbeck belongs; NEP 2020 provided the broader policy invitation to top foreign universities.
